Welcome to my page - I share my work, interests and research journey here.

I’m Justice Adjei Owusu, a PhD student at NCAT focused on V2X communication and applied AI. I enjoy studying the mathematical foundations of AI models and using that understanding to solve problems and explaining complex ideas in simple ways.

What I work on

  • V2X Communication & Intelligent Transportation
  • Reinforcement Learning & Control
  • Applied ML with strong mathematical foundations
  • Energy policy analysis & system reliability

Current goals

I’m actively building a track record that bridges rigorous theory and deployable systems, with the long-term goal of contributing to top AI research teams in industry.
